information: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Spectators may attend for free!** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/) [![Speedcubing.org](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0Z0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ce316f12e822c022ffd1c75d1bdee86c94ccbc2d/image.png)](https://speedcubing.org/) **PLEASE NOTE**: For this competition, there will be competitor limits for some events: **- 6x6 and 7x7: first 40 to register** Spaces are available on a first come first served basis. If you are amongst the first 40 (6x6/7x7) to register for those events, you will get a space in them. If you are not within the first people registered, your registration for that event will be removed after the close of registration. However we will be keeping waiting list for these specific events in the case of dropouts before registration closes. Please only consider registering for these events if you are certain you would like to compete in them.
